subject: Recap & MAP: Redwood Inference POC – next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & MAP: Redwood Inference POC – next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Really appreciate the candid conversation about Acme's priorities and constraints. Quick recap from our end and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points / goals you shared
- High per-call latency and inconsistent tail latency on your current endpoints, impacting customer experience for real-time features.
- Unit cost at scale is a concern — need to reduce token/USD while preserving quality.
- Compliance requirement: logs/audit trail retention for 12 months.
- Decision timeline: exec review w/in 8 weeks; procurement cycle ~4–6 weeks once terms agreed.

Proposed POC goals
1) Validate latency improvement (50% median, 30% p95) for the shopping assistant flow.
2) Demonstrate 30% reduction in per-token cost via batching + KV caching.
3) Ensure audit/logging meets Acme's retention and export needs.

Mutual Action Plan (draft) — milestones & owners
- Week 1 (Nov 8–12): Access & test data handoff — Acme: Samantha & Tom to provide representative traffic sample and test account.
- Week 2 (Nov 15–19): Baseline run on Redwood hosted infra — Redwood: Rishi + Marcus to run baseline and initial optimizations.
- Week 3 (Nov 22–26): Optimization & report — Redwood: Provide latency/cost report and recommended config (quantization/batching).
- Week 4 (Nov 29–Dec 3): Exec review & procurement prep — Acme: Samantha to present results; Procurement to review terms.

Decisions & stakeholders
- Technical sponsor: Samantha Lee (Acme)
- Procurement/commercial: Tom Alvarez + procurement@acme.com
- Redwood exec/CS lead: Marissa Cole
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra; Runtime lead: Marcus Lin

Next steps (actions for this week)
- Samantha/Tom: Share test traffic + any IP allowlist requirements by EOD Friday (Nov 6).
- Rishi: Draft baseline run plan and required credentials, share by Mon Nov 8.
- Marissa: Send MAP doc + milestone tracker (attachment) — attached draft milestones and a short SLA outline.

Attachments: redwood-map-milestones.xlsx (milestone tracker), redwood-sla-draft.pdf (SLA summary)

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Cheers,
Marissa
